description.value: Sidebar Grill is a restaurant and bar in the Latimer Heights neighbourhood of Langley, describing itself as the area's newest culinary destination where classic bar atmosphere meets modern comfort food. The kitchen reimagines comfort food classics with gourmet twists across a broad menu of shareables, tacos, wings, pastas, and mains, complemented by a full bar stocked with craft cocktails, curated beers, and fine wines. The venue hosts live local music nights and private dining, and has earned a Diners' Choice Award from its guests.
